title: Edge assignments induce compatible labelings
statement: Let $q,k,n$ be natural numbers. From a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part and an assignment of labels in $	ext{Fin }n$ to its edges, form the vertex labeling that gives each vertex the label of its matching edge. The resulting pair of matching and vertex labeling has equal labels at the endpoints of every matching edge.
